description: Run bounded CMA-ES/QED search from a SMILES molecule; returns distinct changed molecules or explicit GENERATION_EXHAUSTED when the requested count is not found. Property improvement is not guaranteed. The search uses exactly particles * iterations model decodes and never silently expands this budget. num_molecules must not exceed that product; the runtime enforces this cross-field constraint. Finite-search exhaustion is not proof of chemical infeasibility. QED is a descriptor, not efficacy.

algorithm.description: Actual adaptive CMA-ES with the requested fixed population and iterations.
algorithm.title: Algorithm

iterations.description: Requested CMA-ES ask/tell updates; no automatic increase on exhaustion.
iterations.title: Iterations

min_similarity.description: Hard final-output Morgan/Tanimoto similarity cutoff. It is also used in the soft CMA-ES objective; the hard output filter is stricter than upstream's soft-only score.
min_similarity.title: Min Similarity

minimize.description: Guide search toward lower QED and sort ascending; improvement over the starting molecule is not guaranteed.
minimize.title: Minimize

particles.description: CMA-ES population size, at least two; part of the exact decode budget.
particles.title: Particles

property_name.description: The hosted MolMIM optimizer targets QED only.
property_name.title: Property Name

radius.description: Multiplier of the initial CMA-ES sigma 0.75; not a guaranteed chemical-distance radius.
radius.title: Radius

smi.description: Starting molecule as a valid SMILES string.
smi.title: Smi

output_prefix.description: Directory in your assigned bucket for automatic result.json, artifacts and manifest.json delivery. Defaults to runs/<model-id>; the operation ID is appended. Never sent to the model.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse this key with identical inputs after a lost response.

wait_seconds.description: Wait at most this many seconds; otherwise poll the returned operation ID.

title: GenerateRequest
